name: crs_dep_min
logic: CRSDepTime hhmm to minutes after local midnight (2400 = 1440)

name: crs_arr_min
logic: CRSArrTime hhmm to minutes after local midnight

name: crs_dep_utc
logic: FlightDate + CRSDepTime at the origin, converted to UTC with the airport IANA zone (DST handled)
reason: Schedule only; zone from public reference data

name: crs_arr_utc
logic: Arrival date inferred (first date after departure in UTC), CRSArrTime at the destination, to UTC

name: flight_id
logic: YYYYMMDD-flightnumber-origin-dest-CRSDepTime

name: Tail_Number (normalised)
logic: Trim, upper-case, empty to null
reason: As-flown aircraft; can reflect delay-driven swaps. Used as the rotation key only

name: is_operated
logic: Cancelled = 0 and Diverted = 0

name: struct_null_cancelled / struct_null_diverted / struct_null_delay_cause
logic: Rows whose columns are structurally null by BTS rules

name: dq_missing_tail
logic: Tail_Number is null

name: dq_extreme_delay_24h
logic: DepDelay or ArrDelay above 1440 min

name: dq_time_conflict
logic: UTC block differs from CRSElapsedTime, AirTime > ActualElapsedTime, ArrDel15 inconsistent, etc.

name: dq_duplicate_key
logic: Another row has the same FlightDate, flight number, Origin, Dest, CRSDepTime

name: dq_outlier_other
logic: Taxi over 180 min, departure over 60 min early, elapsed vs schedule over 180 min, invalid distance

name: split
logic: train to 2025-09-30, validate 2025-10 to 2025-12, test 2026-01 to 2026-08, by FlightDate

name: arr_delay_min_capped
logic: ArrDelay clipped to train-period quantiles 0.5% / 99.5%

name: arr_day_offset
logic: Days between departure date and inferred arrival date (0, 1)

name: flag_overnight_arrival
logic: arr_day_offset > 0

name: crs_dep_local / crs_arr_local
logic: Scheduled times as local clock timestamps

name: rotation_id
logic: {tail_number}_{flight_date}
reason: Built from as-flown tail; key only

name: operating_day
logic: FlightDate of the first flight of a run with no rest over 300 min
reason: Depends on the realised tail sequence

name: segment_id
logic: {tail}_{first leg flight_id} of a run of linked operated legs
reason: Realised chain; depends on cancellations and swaps

name: leg_idx
logic: Position of the leg in its segment, 1-based
reason: Realised chain: depends on same-day cancellations and swaps. Needs a leakage review; allowed for the optimiser (planned = operated assumption)

name: n_legs
logic: Legs in the segment
reason: Realised chain: needs a leakage review

name: n_segments
logic: Segments in the tail-day

name: n_downstream_legs
logic: n_legs - leg_idx
reason: Realised chain: a lower bound on planned exposure; needs a leakage review. Allowed for the optimiser

name: n_cancelled_in_tail_day
logic: Cancelled flights of the tail on the date

name: is_first_leg / is_last_leg
logic: leg_idx = 1 / leg_idx = n_legs

name: break_reason_before / break_reason_after
logic: Why a chain starts or ends: first_flight, long_rest, cancelled, diverted, airport_mismatch, swap_suspect

name: category
logic: usable_segment, single_leg_segment, cancelled, diverted, missing_tail, other

name: usable
logic: Operated and in a segment of 2+ legs

name: act_dep_utc / act_arr_utc
logic: Scheduled UTC + DepDelay / ArrDelay

name: primary_delay_min
logic: max(ArrDelay, 0) - coalesce(LateAircraftDelay, 0)

name: sched_ground_min
logic: Next scheduled departure minus scheduled arrival (UTC) for linked legs
reason: Known from the schedule, but defined through the realised tail sequence

name: actual_ground_min
logic: Next actual departure minus actual arrival

name: mtt_min
logic: 10th percentile of actual ground time on time-pressured TRAIN turns by station and time-of-day band (fallbacks, floor 25, cap 60)
reason: Fitted on train outcomes; an assumption, not an observation. Train data only

name: mtt_source
logic: station_band, class_band or global fallback used

name: planned_buffer_min
logic: max(0, sched_ground_min - mtt_min)
reason: Inherits the review needs of both inputs

name: flag_below_mtt
logic: sched_ground_min < mtt_min

name: buffer_bucket
logic: planned buffer bucket: 0, 1-15, 16-30, 31-60, 60+

name: tod_band
logic: Local hour of outbound departure: morning 05-09, midday 10-14, afternoon 15-19, night 20-04

name: station_class
logic: high_volume if a station has at least 20 train turns per day, else other
reason: Estimated on train data; fine if refit on train only

name: turn_index_in_segment / n_downstream_legs_after_turn
logic: Position of the turn and legs after it

name: flag_actual_ground_nonpositive
logic: actual_ground_min <= 0

name: storm_day_flag
logic: FlightDate in 2026-01-24 to 2026-01-28
reason: Defined in hindsight from a known disruption; use to include or exclude days in evaluation

name: high_cancel_day
logic: More than 10% of the day's flights cancelled

name: dep_hour_local
logic: Hour of crs_dep_local
reason: Schedule only; late-arrival rate rises from 10% at 05:00 to 37% at 19:00

name: dep_minute_of_day
logic: crs_dep_min

name: arr_hour_local
logic: Hour of crs_arr_local

name: day_of_week
logic: DayOfWeek

name: month_of_year
logic: Month

name: is_weekend
logic: DayOfWeek in (6, 7)

name: is_us_federal_holiday / days_to_holiday
logic: US federal holiday calendar (public reference) and distance in days
reason: Calendar; known long in advance; reference data to be added

name: origin / dest / route
logic: Airport codes and the origin-dest pair as categorical features
reason: Schedule only; high cardinality, encode on train

name: distance_mi / distance_bin
logic: Distance and binned distance

name: sched_block_min
logic: CRSElapsedTime

name: block_vs_distance_ratio
logic: CRSElapsedTime / Distance: schedule padding

name: tz_offset_diff
logic: Difference in UTC offsets between origin and destination on the day

name: flight_number
logic: Flight_Number_Reporting_Airline

name: origin_dep_density
logic: Number of AA flights scheduled to depart the origin in the same local hour
reason: Congestion proxy from the published schedule

name: dest_arr_density
logic: Number of AA flights scheduled to arrive at the destination in the same local hour
reason: Congestion proxy from the published schedule

name: origin_is_high_volume
logic: Origin class (high_volume / other)

name: hist_route_delay_rate
logic: ArrDel15 rate for the route (origin-dest) in the TRAINING window only, smoothed
reason: Historical delay rates must use the training window only; for training rows use out-of-fold estimates

name: hist_flight_number_delay_rate
logic: ArrDel15 rate by flight number in the training window only

name: hist_origin_hour_delay_rate
logic: ArrDel15 rate by origin and local departure hour in the training window only

name: hist_origin_dow_delay_rate
logic: ArrDel15 rate by origin and day of week in the training window only

name: planned_leg_position
logic: Position of the flight in the aircraft's planned day (needs the planned rotation)
reason: Leg position comes from the realised chain; use only if a planned rotation known before departure can be built

name: planned_inbound_ground_min
logic: Scheduled ground time before the flight (planned turn)
reason: Realised-chain definition; needs a leakage review

name: planned_buffer_before_min
logic: Planned buffer before the flight
reason: Inherits MTT assumption and chain review
